entities.summary: Shams al-Din Muhammad Mahmud Shahrazuri knowns as Shahrazuri was a 13th-century Muslim physician, historian and philosopher. He was of Kurdish origin. It appears that he was alive in AD 1288. However, it is also said that he died in the same year.
